source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 30 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Valentin, Episcopul Umbriei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Ουαλεντίνος ο Ιερομάρτυρας Επίσκοπος Τέρνι»

attestations.note: Terni is the Italian name of Interamna, and the whole of saint.gr's entry is that he was bishop of the city of Terni and was martyred at Rome — the same office as this folder's. The Greek day is 14 February and the Romanian row on this folder keeps him on 30 July; one row per church is the schema, so the two stand side by side. saint.gr keeps a second Valentine on the same 14 February, a presbyter of Rome, on a page of his own, and the two are two men.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor Apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţă răbdând până la sânge, Sfinţite Mucenice Valentin, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

english.text: A sharer in their ways and a successor to the apostles' thrones, you found in action, God-inspired one, a way up to the vision of the things on high. Therefore, rightly teaching the word of truth and enduring in faith even to blood, hieromartyr Valentine, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.
